::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 8th [1870]  
**From:** Elderfield,  Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, C0171: Box 29
:::

Dear [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd),
I enclose a cheque for the remainder of [Campanella](other_books/otherbook_502.qmd) and send at the same time a proof of [Mr Peabody](other_books/otherbook_6562.qmd), hoping you will not sacrifice the modest request which seems to me too good to be lost.

Thank you for [Miss Tucker’](people/person_1424.qmd)s address  I hope she has heard from [Mr Warne](people/person_1433.qmd) by this time[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

[Lady Betty](other_books/otherbook_788.qmd)is an admirable story

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: Miss Tucker may perhaps have been author of one of the Victoria Tales and Stories series edited by CMY and published by Warne.
